name: Focus Notebook
shortDescription: A lay-flat notebook designed to keep plans clear and ideas close.
description: The Focus Notebook gives daily thinking a calm, useful home. Its thread-sewn binding opens completely flat, while softly ruled pages leave enough structure for plans without getting in the way of sketches and ideas.

name: Everyday Bottle
shortDescription: Double-wall steel that keeps drinks cold without adding bulk.
description: A slim, balanced bottle for commutes and long desk sessions. The powder-coated exterior stays easy to grip, while the wide mouth makes refilling, adding ice, and cleaning straightforward.

name: Pocket Power Bank
shortDescription: Reliable backup power in a compact, travel-friendly form.
description: Small enough for a jacket pocket and capable enough for a full day away from a socket. The Pocket Power Bank charges phones, earbuds, and other essentials through a fast USB-C connection.

name: Canvas Carryall
shortDescription: A structured daily tote with room for work, groceries, and detours.
description: The Canvas Carryall is built for days that do not follow one plan. A reinforced base keeps it upright, two interior pockets separate small items, and long handles sit comfortably over the shoulder.

name: Soft Light Lamp
shortDescription: Warm, adjustable light for reading, working, and winding down.
description: Soft Light creates a focused pool of warm illumination without glare. Its tactile dial moves smoothly from a quiet evening glow to a brighter setting suited to detailed work.

name: Desk Timer
shortDescription: A simple visual timer for focused work without another screen.
description: Turn the dial and begin. The Desk Timer shows remaining time at a glance and ends with a gentle chime, making it easier to work in deliberate intervals without opening an app.
